Name: Automate Pro
Author: palmhacker13
Description:
[center]
[size=6][b][color=#1890ff]Automate Pro[/color][/b][/size]
[size=4][i]An event-driven, zero-allocation automation engine for Stardew Valley 1.6+[/i][/size]

[b][color=#52c41a]Event-Driven & Reactive[/color]  •  [color=#fa8c16]Visual Network Overlay[/color]  •  [color=#722ed1]Smart Chest I/O & Routing[/color][/b]
[/center]

[line]

[size=5][b]📖 What Does This Mod Do?[/b][/size]

[b]Automate Pro[/b] connects chests, machines, and storages into automated networks so raw materials flow into machines and finished products are collected automatically—built from the ground up for [b]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/b] and [b]SMAPI 4.0+[/b] with a focus on minimal frame-time impact.

Instead of scanning every tile on every tick, [b]Automate Pro[/b] reacts to machine-ready hooks, inventory updates, and unified sub-minute scheduling:
[list=1]
[*][b]Instant Reactive Chaining[/b]: When a machine finishes processing, outputs are pushed immediately to storage or the next machine in the chain.[/*]
[*][b]Interactive Visual Overlay (Press [font=Courier New]U[/font])[/b]: Inspect connected groups, flow directions, machine progress, and blocked states right in the world.[/*]
[*][b]Per-Chest Flow Modes[/b]: While the Overlay is active, right-click any Chest, Big Chest, Junimo Chest, Fridge, or Auto-Grabber to cycle between [b]Normal [I/O][/b], [b]Input Only [IN][/b], [b]Output Only [OUT][/b], and [b]Ignored [OFF][/b] without opening the chest menu.[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[center]
[size=5][b]⚡ Ecosystem Synergy[/b][/size]
[/center]

[quote]
[b]Automate Pro[/b] integrates natively with your performance and automation stack (all optional):
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/50971][b][color=#1890ff]UltraSmooth[/color][/b][/url]: Uses UltraSmooth's fast spatial object lookup when available for faster topology checks.[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/games/stardewvalley/mods/55495][b][color=#52c41a]Next-Gen Auto-Grabber[/color][/b][/url]: Exposes [font=Courier New]IAutomateProApi[/font] so auto-grabbers can push harvested items directly into your Automate Pro networks.[/*]
[*][b]Legacy Automate Mod Bridges[/b]: Includes an optional [font=Courier New]IAutomateApi[/font] compatibility bridge for custom machines from third-party mods.[/*]
[/list][/quote]
[line]

[size=5][b]✨ Features[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][b]Broad Machine & World Support[/b]: Chests, Big Chests, Junimo Chests, FarmHouse/Island Fridges, Mini-Shipping Bins, Shipping Bins, Auto-Grabbers, Casks, Kegs, Preserves Jars, Crab Pots, Incubators, Geode Crushers, Deconstructors, Fruit Trees, Berry Bushes, Tappers, Tree Moss, Slime Troughs, Statues, and Flooring/Path Connectors (with optional Diagonal Adjacency & Fence/Gate connectors).[/*]
[*][b]Advanced Chest I/O Modes[/b]: Right-click storages while the [font=Courier New]U[/font] Overlay is open to switch [b]I/O[/b] ➔ [b]Input Only[/b] ➔ [b]Output Only[/b] ➔ [b]Ignored[/b].[/*]
[*][b]Cross-Location Relays ([font=Courier New]#global[/font], [font=Courier New]#ch:X[/font])[/b]: Tag chests to share inventories across the Farm, Sheds, Greenhouse, Barns, and Ginger Island.[/*]
[*][b]Smart Priority & Profit Maximizer[/b]: Route high-value crops and artisan goods first, configure per-machine priority preferences (Keg, Preserves Jar, Cask, Furnace, Dehydrator, Fish Smoker, etc.), and protect tools/weapons from being consumed.[/*]
[*][b]Buffer Limits & Overflow Policies[/b]: Keep a configurable minimum item buffer in chests, or auto-ship overflow items when chests fill up.[/*]
[*][b]Swarm Co-Processing & Fleet Resync[/b]: Optional machine cluster assistance and Perfectionist batch synchronization.[/*]
[*][b]Live Visual Overlay & Flow Particles[/b]: Toggle with [font=Courier New]U[/font] (customizable) to see color-coded groups, live directional flow particles, and hover inspection cards.[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=5][b]📥 Installation & Menu Support[/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*]Install [b]SMAPI[/b] (version 4.0.0+).[/*]
[*]Download and unzip [font=Courier New]AutomatePro[/font] into your [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font] folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game and customize any setting via [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098][b]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/b][/url] or [font=Courier New]config.json[/font].[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=5][b]💻 Console Commands[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][font=Courier New][b]automate_summary[/b][/font] (or [font=Courier New][b]ap_status[/b][/font]) — Displays active Automate Pro groups, machines, and storages.[/*]
[*][font=Courier New][b]amp_metrics[/b][/font] — Displays real-time performance telemetry (frametime saved, allocations prevented, reactive dispatches, and instant chains).[/*]
[/list]
